name: faq-accordion
title: FAQ: Accordion
description: A centered heading over the questions as a column of cards that open one at a time.
author: DressCode UI <https://dresscodeui.com>

files.content:
// FAQ, accordion: a centered heading over the questions, each one its own card that opens in place. One // answer is open at a time and the first starts open, so the section never looks empty. import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger } from "@/components/ui/accordion" const FAQS = [ ["Is Orbit really free for three clients?", "Yes. The Free plan has no time limit and no card on file. You only pay when you add a fourth client or want the Studio features."], ["What does it cost to get paid?", "Card payments cost 2.9% + 30¢ and bank transfers 0.8%, capped at $5. Fees are shown on every invoice before you send it, and you can pass them on to the client."], ["Will my clients need an account?", "No. They get an email with a link to the invoice and pay in a minute. They can come back to the same link to download receipts."], ["Can reminders really sound like me?", "You write the first reminder, or pick a tone, and Orbit keeps that voice for the others. You can read every reminder before it goes out."], ["Can I import my clients and old invoices?", "Yes. Import a CSV from your spreadsheet or your old tool, and Orbit keeps the invoice numbers going from where you left off."], ["Is my data safe?", "Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, sign-in supports two-step codes, and every change is logged. You can export or delete everything at any time."], ["Can I cancel any time?", "Yes. Cancel from settings and you drop to the Free plan at the end of the period. Your invoices stay where they are."], ] const link = "rounded-sm font-semibold text-foreground underline underline-offset-4 outline-none hover:text-[color:var(--dc-accent)] focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50" export default function FaqAccordion() { return (

FAQ

Questions, answered

The things people ask most before they send their first invoice with Orbit.

{FAQS.map(([q, a], i) => ( {q} {a} ))}

Still unsure? Browse the{" "} help center {" "} or{" "} write to us .

) }

The block is in components/dresscode/faq-accordion.tsx; render it in any page.
It wears your DressCode theme (its colors, fonts and corners, and the dc-* classes the theme adds). Pick one at https://dresscodeui.com/themes, e.g. npx shadcn@latest add https://dresscodeui.com/r/dresscode/mono.json
